_comment: Tier-2: SmallDisplacementThermoMechanicElement2D4N needs nodal TEMPERATURE and DAM.NODAL_REFERENCE_TEMPERATURE, and Properties needs DAM.THERMAL_EXPANSION — the Dam variable, not the StructuralMechanics one. Pitfall (kratos.dam #3). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Both NODAL_REFERENCE_TEMPERATURE and THERMAL_EXPANSION resolve on DamApplication and on NEITHER StructuralMechanicsApplication nor core, so the module the reader would reach for is the wrong one; the element itself constructs. TEMPERATURE is a core variable, so the pair straddles two modules. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
